race.comment: HARD AS BROK (8) resumed with residual fitness on his side for a closing fourth from back in the field over 1181m at Grafton. Ready for this trip and further now and sure to be around the money. SMART SCUD (7) lightly raced gelding who looks to have a bright future. Held his ground to the line first up with the 58kg when fourth over 1200m at Narromine. Lone win came second up and likely to go back from the barrier. Each way contender. JAGERSCHNITZEL (9) win record hardly excites but looks to have come back much stronger this time in. Set to peak third up and look for him to launch late. BLAZED PRINCE (11) Drew out and pushed forward early but weakened out of it late when eighth over 1600m at this track last time. Draws a low gate and look for an improved run here.
